evidence.decision: After ancient, Ptolemaic, and 1953–1958 Republic of Egypt Activities are removed and Sadat's 1970–1971 UAR-name phase is split away, preserve polity UUID 8c25246a-3d73-4df9-8e4a-b0c5ca97c241 as the Arab Republic of Egypt survivor and replace its generic preferred display names.
evidence.identity_rule: The contaminated generic Egypt UUID survives only for the post-2 September 1971 Arab Republic of Egypt identity; earlier unrelated historical identities are represented by their own reviewed polity UUIDs.
